title: Xero or TaxCalc questions

transcript.content: Do I need to buy Xero myself for Making Tax Digital?

For independent DIY use, HMRC publishes a list of Making Tax Digital compatible software on GOV.UK, and you can choose a product that fits your situation. TaxSimba is an accountant-led service: for customers on Simbian plans, Xero is included in the monthly price for the accountant-led MTD workflow (you do not buy Xero separately through TaxSimba). For Self Assessment filing workflows TaxSimba’s accountants use TaxCalc — that is internal to the service, not a product TaxSimba sells you to run alone. SIMBA will not invent that TaxSimba is mandatory or HMRC-endorsed. If you prefer full accountant-led support instead of DIY software, say whether you need Self Assessment, Making Tax Digital, or both.
What is TaxCalc used for at TaxSimba?

TaxCalc is the software TaxSimba’s accountants use for Self Assessment filing workflows. It is part of how TaxSimba delivers accountant-led SA services — not a separate product you are routinely expected to buy and run yourself through SIMBA. The TaxSimba portal handles registration, payment, documents and messaging with your assigned accountant; the portal itself is not a direct HMRC filing integration. SIMBA will not invent that customers must purchase TaxCalc independently to use TaxSimba. If you want Self Assessment support, ask which SA package fits, or email info@taxsimba.co.uk for general service questions.
Does the TaxSimba portal file directly to HMRC?

The TaxSimba portal supports registration, payment, document collection, customer workflows and messaging with your assigned accountant. It is not itself a direct HMRC filing integration. Filing and MTD submissions are accountant-led using TaxSimba’s internal tools (TaxCalc for Self Assessment filing workflows; Xero for Making Tax Digital). SIMBA chat cannot file or submit to HMRC. After signup: create an account, verify email, choose your package, pay, then use the dashboard for onboarding and accountant messaging.

The lowest Simbian price for accountant-led Making Tax Digital support is £29.99 per month (VAT included) for the Simbian Comply package. This package includes Xero Simple as part of the monthly price. If you're interested in signing up or need more details, let me know!
